body: Implemented min(values) in src/math.mjs (appended after stddev, R-1 validation identical to mean) and appended exactly four ^min tests to test/math.test.mjs, extending the line-3 import only. Required check 1 (node --test --test-name-pattern="^min" test/) reported tests 4, pass 4, fail 0; required check 2 (git diff --unified=0 HEAD -- src/math.mjs) showed only the 16-line addition block with no removed lines. npm test on the checkout gives pass 18, fail 1 where the single failure is the known baseline 'clamp respects upper bound' (by design until T5), reported as a known failure, never as a pass; no questions were asked and nothing is left open.
